svg.title: Diagram: three surfaces, one currency
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram of three boxes — Notes, Wiki Page, Standing File — each naming its upkeep currency, with dashed arrows to a dashed box reading Stale, Still Cited, and a note card reading The Receipt listing a date on the synthesis, a lint report read, and a file line tied to a failure.

text.tspan: a lint report read, not filed
a file line tied to a failure it fixed
Carried claims re-derived from run records and primaries opened 11 Nov 2026.
Dashed paths show what happens when upkeep stops. No new tests in this run.
